evidence.section: 3.3 Tensile and compression properties of sintered bulk
evidence.quote: The actual mechanical properties of Ti/Al/Nb sintered bulk obtained from the compression experiment were yield strength (YS) of 842 MPa, ultimate compressive strength of 1314 MPa, plastic elongation to fracture of 12.4%, respectively (in Fig.6 (b)).

evidence.section: 3.3 Tensile and compression properties of sintered bulk
evidence.quote: The results showed that the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of Ti/Al/Nb sintered bulk was 286 MPa(in Fig. 6(a)) and the compression intensity was up to 1200 MPa, which was higher than UTS.

mechanisms.name: toughening effect of Nb on the TiAl matrix

evidence.section: 3.3 Tensile and compression properties of sintered bulk
evidence.quote: The excellent ductility of TiAl-based composite with high-content Nb could be attributed to the toughening effect of Nb on the TiAl matrix.
